newsitem.title: UK: UK PM - Wirral loss won't alter election date.
newsitem.headline: UK PM - Wirral loss won't alter election date.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Friday that his party's defeat in the Wirral by-election would not alter his preferred date for a general election.

"I don't believe last night's by-election result, although it puts us in a minority of one, will alter the date I have in mind for the election," Major said in a broadcast interview during a visit to Scotland.
Major refused to say if May 1 was his top choice, as is widely believed, but predicted the Conservatives would win.

On Thursday, Labour candidate Ben Chapman overturned a Conservative majority of 8,183 votes to win the affluent northwestern constituency of Wirral South by a margin of 7,888 votes. Major vowed to recapture the seat at the general election, which must be held by May 22.
